messages.text: do you ship to Australia with AU socket, 240v at the wall?

Yes, we ship to Australia. The B30 goes out with an EU-type plug plus an adapter, and it runs fine on 240V — it's a universal-input supply. At 405 W it's about 292 kWh a month.

What do you pay per kWh there?

Solar is the best case for this — your power cost is basically whatever the panels don't use elsewhere, so the sats you stack are yours.

405 W is light enough to run straight off a modest array in daylight, battery overnight if you want it hashing 24/7. Every ten minutes it's a fresh draw at a full block, and you still own the machine after.

Is it going in the house or a garage/shed?

A shed is ideal — noise doesn't matter and the heat goes nowhere near your living space. Just keep it out of direct sun and give it airflow; Australian summer sheds get hot and the fans will ramp.

The B30 is $899, 30 TH/s, and Batch 5 ships November 30, 2026. Want me to set it up for you?
Before you go, one thing: what made the B30 the one you landed on?
Makes sense — thanks for telling me. Enjoy the build, and shout if anything comes up.
